texts.TXT-VERIFIED: We checked a digital signature sent with the request: it really comes from the operator it names.
texts.TXT-ATTESTED: Cloudflare, which delivers this site, recognises this visitor as a known bot or agent. We rely on its judgement but cannot see how it reached it.
texts.TXT-DECLARED: The visitor names itself, but nothing confirms it. Anyone can use any name.
texts.TXT-PEOPLE: Looks like a person using a browser. This group also includes AI agents that work inside a browser without identifying themselves.
texts.TXT-CONTRADICTED: Uses the name of a bot Cloudflare normally recognises, but Cloudflare did not recognise it this time — usually someone borrowing the name.
texts.TXT-SIG-INVALID: Sent a signature that did not check out. Treat the claimed identity as false.
texts.TXT-SIG-UNCHECKED: Sent a signature we could not check at the time of the visit.
texts.TXT-LIMITS: Some AI agents can't be told apart from people: those running in a browser on the user's own device, and those answering from a search index without visiting the site.

kindTexts.people: Looks like a person using a browser. This group also includes AI agents that work inside a browser without identifying themselves.
kindTexts.ai-assistant: Fetches pages live on behalf of a user who asked an AI assistant something, for example ChatGPT, Claude or Perplexity answering a question.
kindTexts.search: Indexes pages for search results, AI search included, for example Googlebot, Bingbot or OAI-SearchBot.
kindTexts.ai-training: Collects pages in bulk to train AI models, for example GPTBot, ClaudeBot or CCBot. Not tied to any one user's question.
kindTexts.other-bot: Other automated visitors without an AI purpose: link previews, monitoring, SEO tools, feed readers.
kindTexts.unknown: Automated, but nothing says what it is: not a browser, no known name, not recognised by Cloudflare. Includes custom-built agents and scripts.
